title: CrowdStrike Agrees to Acquire Zscaler for $44 Billion
excerpt: Cybersecurity firm CrowdStrike has announced a $44 billion acquisition of Zscaler to enhance enterprise AI agent capabilities.
body_html:
Cybersecurity leader CrowdStrike has announced plans to acquire Zscaler in a deal valued at $44 billion.

Zscaler specializes in zero-trust products designed for large enterprise customers. According to CrowdStrike, the acquisition will better equip their clients to utilize artificial intelligence agents securely and effectively.

Further details regarding the transaction timeline and integration plans were not provided in the announcement.
